en.headline: A place for how you feel.
en.intro: Write a local diary, talk with Aurora, and keep small reminders beside a cloud of polar light.
en.ways_title: Write privately. Or start a conversation.
en.ways_intro: Two different actions share the same calm space. Choose the one you need.
en.diary_title: Zen Writing stays on this device
en.diary_body: Open the feather button beside the chat box. Write without a conversation, choose a mood and topic, then Save to Diary. You can edit or delete the entry later in My diary. This save does not request an AI response.
en.chat_title: Chat asks Aurora for a reply
en.chat_body: Send a message in the main chat box. Aurora replies online and may suggest small activities. Keep a suggestion by adding it to the wall; the app does not add every suggestion automatically.
en.zen_caption: The actual Zen Writing editor, with an unsaved sample draft. No AI response was requested.
features: Aurora’s expression changes with emotions, while the topic changes its palette. Typing and tapping also trigger local reactions. These expressions are part of the interface, not a measurement of your mental state.

Pin a suggested activity, drag the note into place, mark it complete or remove it. Move around the canvas and use Center view to return to the bottle. Notes and their positions are saved in this browser.
A history you can return to

My diary contains your saved writing. Chat history groups the conversation by date. Mood calendar is a day-by-day timeline of recorded moods, with the most frequent mood and topic for each day. It is not a clinical chart.
steps: Enter Aurora directly. You do not need Google sign-in or your own API key to use the hosted app.
Use the feather for a local diary entry, or the main text box for an online conversation. Mood and topic selectors belong to the writing screen.
Save a useful suggestion to the wall. Open the menu in the top-right for diary, chat history and the mood timeline.
Use Export backup in the menu. Keep the downloaded JSON somewhere you control before clearing browser data or changing devices.

en.local_body: Diary entries, saved chats, wall notes, mood history and preferences are kept in this browser’s storage. There is no account sync. Another browser, device or app address has a separate copy; clearing site data can remove it.
en.online_title: What is sent when you chat
en.online_body: Your message, recent conversation, wall notes and selected context are sent to the app’s server and then to OpenAI to generate a reply. Zen diary entries are excluded from chat history context. The OpenAI key stays on the server. Local storage does not mean the chat is offline or end-to-end encrypted.
en.backup_title: Move your records with a JSON backup
backup_steps: The downloaded file includes chats, diary, wall notes, mood records and preferences. It is readable JSON, so keep it somewhere private.
Choose Import backup and select an Aurora v1 JSON file up to 10 MB. Validation and the record-count preview happen in your browser; the file is not uploaded.

Replace records and restore replaces the current snapshot; it does not merge two collections. Export current records first. Cancel or a rejected file leaves the current records unchanged. Wait for any active AI reply before restoring.
en.limit: Aurora is a personal reflection tool. Its character, mood tags and AI suggestions are not a diagnosis or professional care.
en.run_body: The local Vite app supports the diary and browser storage. Online chat also needs the server API running with a server-side OpenAI key; Vite by itself does not provide that endpoint.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline: 给此刻的情绪，一个位置。
zh.intro: 写本地日记，与 Aurora 对话，把小小的提醒留在极光云身旁。
zh.ways_title: 可以安静书写，也可以开始对话。
zh.ways_intro: 同一个空间里，两种不同的操作。选择你现在需要的方式。
zh.diary_title: Zen 书写保存在这台设备
zh.diary_body: 点击对话框旁的羽毛按钮，进入独立书写界面。写下文字，选择情绪与主题，再点 Save to Diary。之后可以在“我的日记”里编辑或删除。这次保存不会请求 AI 回复。
zh.chat_title: 对话会向 Aurora 请求回复
zh.chat_body: 在主界面的输入框发送消息，Aurora 会在线回复，也可能建议一些小活动。觉得有用时，再亲手把建议添加到墙上；应用不会自动保存每一条建议。
zh.zen_caption: 真实的 Zen 书写界面，使用尚未保存的示例草稿。未请求 AI 回复。
zh.features_title: 极光瓶周围，能留下什么？
features: 情绪改变 Aurora 的表情，主题改变它的配色。打字和轻触也会触发本地回应。这些表情是界面设计，并不是对心理状态的测量。
把建议贴上墙，拖到喜欢的位置，标记完成或移除。可以移动画布，再用 Center view 回到极光瓶。便签内容与位置会保存在当前浏览器。
“我的日记”收纳保存的书写；“对话记录”按日期整理聊天。“情绪日历”是逐日记录的时间线，显示每天较常出现的情绪与主题，不是临床图表。
steps: 不需要 Google 登录。使用已部署的应用，也不需要自己填写 API key。
羽毛按钮打开本地日记，主输入框用于在线聊天。情绪与主题选择器位于书写界面。
把有用的建议贴上便签墙。右上角菜单里可以打开日记、对话记录和情绪时间线。
在菜单中选择“导出备份”。清理浏览器数据或更换设备前，把下载的 JSON 文件保存到自己管理的位置。

zh.data_title: 记录在本地，对话需联网。
zh.local_body: 日记、已保存的对话、便签、情绪历史和偏好保存在当前浏览器的存储中，不通过账号同步。换浏览器、设备或应用地址会使用不同的数据副本；清理网站数据可能删除记录。
zh.online_title: 聊天时会发送哪些内容
zh.online_body: 你发送的消息、近期对话、墙上便签与所选上下文会发给应用服务端，再交由 OpenAI 生成回复。日记条目不包含在聊天历史上下文里。OpenAI key 保留在服务端。本地存储并不意味着聊天离线运行或采用端到端加密。
zh.backup_title: 用 JSON 备份迁移记录
backup_steps: 下载文件包含对话、日记、便签、情绪记录和偏好。它是可读的 JSON，请存放在私密位置。
选择“导入备份”，打开不超过 10 MB 的 Aurora v1 JSON 文件。校验和记录数量预览都在浏览器中完成，文件不会上传。
“确认替换并恢复”会用备份替换当前快照，不会合并两份记录。建议先导出当前记录。取消或文件校验失败不会改变当前数据；有 AI 回复正在生成时，需等待完成再恢复。
zh.limit: Aurora 用于个人记录与回看。角色表情、情绪标签和 AI 建议都不是诊断，也不能代替专业照护。
zh.run_body: 本地 Vite 应用支持日记和浏览器存储。在线聊天还需要运行服务端 API，并在服务端配置 OpenAI key；单独启动 Vite 不会提供这个接口。
